data.name: Concert of Minds
data.description: As long as your collective members are under this effect, a member of the collective can take a standard action to aid another member when he is manifesting.  This adds a +1 bonus to the manifester's effective manifesting level.  This cannot go higher than +%1.  Note that at most, only four members of the collective can aid a single individual.|ConcertOfMindsMaxBonus
